options.error: The first line must follow Conventional Commits with an uppercase subject: <type>(<scope>): Subject (a body and trailers may follow after a blank line)

actions.action: echo '🔒 Scanning for secrets...' && if ! command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Note: gitleaks not available in this environment; CI still scans on push'; exit 0; fi; gitleaks protect --staged --verbose --redact --config=.gitleaks.toml

echo '🔒 Scanning commits for secrets...' && if ! command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Note: gitleaks not available in this environment; CI still scans on push'; exit 0; fi; default_ref=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^refs/remotes/@@'); gitleaks detect --verbose --redact --config=.gitleaks.toml --log-opts="${default_ref:-origin/develop}..HEAD"
